description: Gold evaluation set for RegIntel. Each item has a question and the article(s) that actually contain the answer, used to measure retrieval accuracy. 'expected_articles' lists article numbers considered correct hits for that regulation. Extend this set with real questions from your compliance team.

items.question: Within what timeframe must a major ICT-related incident be reported to the competent authority?
How are ICT-related incidents classified as major?
items.notes: Classification of ICT-related incidents and cyber threats.

items.question: What key contractual provisions must be included in agreements with ICT third-party service providers?
What must the register of information on contractual arrangements with ICT third-party providers contain?
What is threat-led penetration testing and who must perform it?
items.notes: Advanced testing of ICT tools based on TLPT.

items.question: Who holds ultimate responsibility for managing ICT risk within a financial entity?
items.notes: Governance and organisation — management body responsibility.

items.question: Bir bankanın SOC hizmeti bağlı bir grup şirketi tarafından sağlanıyorsa, ICT üçüncü taraf riski açısından hangi yükümlülükler geçerlidir?
items.notes: Intra-group ICT third-party arrangements. Turkish question against English index — tests query rewriting.

items.question: Büyük bir ICT olayı yetkili otoriteye ne kadar sürede raporlanmalıdır?
Within how many hours must a personal data breach be notified to the supervisory authority?
items.notes: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority (72 hours).

items.question: When is a data protection impact assessment required?
What rights does a data subject have to access their personal data?
items.notes: Right of access by the data subject.

items.question: What technical and organisational measures are required to secure personal data processing?
When must a Data Protection Officer be appointed?
items.notes: Designation of the data protection officer.

items.question: What is the right to erasure and when does it apply?
items.notes: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten').

items.question: Veri sorumlusunun veri güvenliğine ilişkin yükümlülükleri nelerdir?
Özel nitelikli kişisel veriler nasıl işlenebilir?
items.notes: Özel nitelikli kişisel verilerin işlenme şartları.

items.question: Kişisel verilerin silinmesi, yok edilmesi veya anonim hale getirilmesi ne zaman gerekir?
items.notes: Kişisel verilerin silinmesi, yok edilmesi veya anonim hale getirilmesi.
